In this snapshot the default multiprocessing start method on supported POSIX platforms other than macOS is `forkserver`.

```json
{"facts": {"default": "forkserver"}}
```

`library/multiprocessing.rst` has a "versionchanged 3.14" note saying that on POSIX platforms the default start method was changed from fork to forkserver. The `spawn` method is described there as the default on Windows and macOS, which is why the answer excludes macOS.

`library/concurrent.futures.rst` agrees that the default process start method changed away from fork in 3.14. `deprecations/pending-removal-in-3.14.rst` and `whatsnew/3.12.rst` announce the earlier plan to change the default on non-macOS POSIX platforms.
